explanation: This unit tracks how far into the episode the agent is: it stays at 10 on almost every step through about trial 55 (sometimes 9 at GO), then slowly drops, so around trials 60-80 D1 is about 10, GO about 7-8 and D2 about 9, and from about trial 85 on it falls sharply, with GO lowest (0-5, near 0 by trials 91-99), D2 in the middle (about 7 falling to 0-2) and D1 highest. In that late part, D1 after a rewarded trial stays fairly high (about 9 around trial 85, falling to 4-6 by trial 99), but D1 after an unrewarded trial is much lower (about 4 around trial 88, then 0-2 near trial 95-99); choice and common versus rare transitions barely matter.
